description: Working with Liongard's engineering team on cybersecurity integrations and inspectors, primarily using TypeScript/Node.js and AWS. Developing and maintaining integration workflows using services such as AWS Lambda, SQS, S3, and CloudWatch. Also contributed to the Go-based Liongard agent, working on inspector-related functionality and agent workflows.

Worked on backend APIs and services for gaming and contest workflows, using Redis, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and RabbitMQ. Contributed to real-time communication using WebSockets and Socket.IO, including Redis-backed scaling across multiple service instances. Also worked on Kafka-based request tracking and Snowflake analytics, and developed APIs supporting fraud analysis using Neo4j.

Worked on the Pray mobile application (now Sanskriti), contributing to both the React Native app and its backend. Migrated the application's backend from Firebase to a custom Node.js/Express and MongoDB stack, building REST APIs and scheduled jobs. Also contributed to ONDC integration and implemented Server-Sent Events for real-time updates.
Description of what you did, impact you made, and problems you solved.
